mapper.select: SELECT id, indicator_code as indicatorCode, indicator_name as indicatorName, category, syndrome_type as syndromeType, description, formula, unit, threshold_json as thresholdJson, data_source as dataSource, status, sort_order as sortOrder FROM monitor_indicator ORDER BY category, sort_order, indicator_code

SELECT id, indicator_code as indicatorCode, indicator_name as indicatorName, category, syndrome_type as syndromeType, description, formula, unit, threshold_json as thresholdJson, data_source as dataSource, status, sort_order as sortOrder FROM monitor_indicator WHERE syndrome_type IS NULL OR syndrome_type = '' OR syndrome_type = #{syndromeType} ORDER BY category, sort_order

SELECT id, indicator_code as indicatorCode, indicator_name as indicatorName, category, syndrome_type as syndromeType, description, formula, unit, threshold_json as thresholdJson, data_source as dataSource, status, sort_order as sortOrder FROM monitor_indicator WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monitor_indicator (indicator_code, indicator_name, category, syndrome_type, description, formula, unit, threshold_json, data_source, status, sort_order) VALUES (#{indicatorCode}, #{indicatorName}, #{category}, #{syndromeType}, #{description}, #{formula}, #{unit}, #{thresholdJson}, #{dataSource}, #{status}, #{sortOrder})
